Evan C: Hey people-ops team — quick onboarding questions. I accepted the relocation allowance in my offer (one-time $2,000). Will that show as separate line on my first paycheck or as a bonus later? Also trying to opt into the WFH stipend but I don't see the option in Benefits. Finally: where do I set my 401k beneficiary?

Rosa (People Ops): Congrats on the new role, Evan! :tada: Relocation is typically coded as a one-time taxable relocation payment and is paid on the first payroll after HR submits the payment to Finance. It will appear as "Relocation Payment" on your paystub. If you want it earlier, DM me and I can check timing with Finance.

Evan C: Good to know — is tax withheld at supplemental rate or regular withholding? Trying to estimate net.

Payroll Bot: Payroll note: Lump-sum relocation payments are taxed as supplemental wages. Default withholding is the flat supplemental rate (22% federal as of 2025) unless you requested aggregate withholding. State taxes apply per state rules. See Workday > Pay > Pay Statements for exact net once processed.

Evan C: Ok thanks. About WFH stipend — I thought remote folks got $75/mo pre-tax? I checked Benefits portal and only see "Perks" empty.

Benefits Admin: WFH stipend is an opt-in perk under Benefits > Perks in Workday. It may take 24h after hire to appear. Also note: it's a non-taxable reimbursement if you submit monthly receipts under the "WFH" policy; otherwise it's treated as a taxable stipend. If you want the automatic monthly stipend, enroll and then upload a receipt each month to avoid taxable treatment.

Connor M: Quick FYI — some people just opt for the monthly e-claim via Expensify and tag "WFH-stip"; People Ops auto-validates receipts under $75. Works well.

Evan C: Helpful. Where do I add 401k beneficiary? I tried the vendor portal link but it asked for a one-time login code and timed out.

Rosa (People Ops): 401k beneficiary can be set in the retirement vendor portal (link in Workday) or in Workday under Benefits > Retirement > Beneficiaries. If the vendor link times out, try the vendor portal directly and use the one-time code sent to your email. If the code doesn't arrive, ping us and we'll re-trigger it.

Evan C: Also submitted a relocation expense (movers & deposit) via Expensify for reimbursement — tagged "relocation". It's been "Pending - People Ops" for 2 business days. Any ETA?

Finance: Reimbursements flow: People Ops reviews within 3 business days. After approval, Finance pays on the next AP run (Tue/Thu). For relocation category we validate receipts and proof of move; larger amounts can require expense committee sign-off which adds a day.

Evan C: Understood. One last odd thing — my pay preview shows a small deduction labeled "Loan Repay" I never signed up for. Who to contact?

Payroll Bot: If you see unexpected deductions, submit a ticket to payroll@redwood.ai with a screenshot. We can trace deduction codes (401k, HSA, Loan, Wage Garnish). If it's a legacy vendor entry, Payroll can zero it before the run if reported within 48h.

Rosa (People Ops): Evan — DM me the Expensify link and I'll flag the relocation expense. Also send the screenshot of that deduction and we'll open a payroll trace. Welcome aboard! :rocket:
